entities.name: Olli Määttä
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olli Määttä is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a defenceman for the Calgary Flames of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was drafted in the first round, 22nd overall, by the Pittsburgh Penguins in the 2012 NHL entry draft. Määttä has also played for the Chicago Blackhawks, Los Angeles Kings, Detroit Red Wings and Utah Mammoth.
